notes.title: 🎮 Artisan TD is 100% Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/f8e41531139a294c9572927c378e2a7aa05cadbc.png

ːwallː Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce that Artisan TD has achieved Steam Deck Verified status after passing Valve's extensive testing.

Don't hesitate to download the game on this platform now if you haven't yet managed to complete your exploration ːinsectoid_tdː
We'd like to take this opportunity to thank you for all your feedback. Since we pushed the Prince Mode update in February, we've had a lot of messages, and it's great to see you enjoying the game.
For our part, we're actively working on the next steps and will soon be celebrating (with you?) the game's first year!

ːstein_lː Thanks for your support and see you soon! ːstein_rː

notes.title: Artisan TD 1.3: The Prince Mode update has arrived!
notes.content:
Super patch 1.3 and Artisan TD Demo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/7bca4ad399dc758435387d37a9c88cec13f5e860.png

Hello everyone!

We are very happy to present to you patch 1.3. Thanks to your feedback, we understood some players wanted a tower defense with more freedom, and that is less punishing. Thus, we wanted to meet that need by creating the Prince mode!
Available in the three difficulty settings, this new mode allows a more relaxed experience, closer to the traditionnal tower defense spirit. With that said, if you appreciate the “puzzle” and “die and retry” philosophy of the original game, rest assured: you can keep playing the classic mode.

Have fun and don't hesitate to send us your feedback!


Content Addition

New Prince Mode!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/f25ac668f2b47b11ca2613cc30cb9aef2329d016.png
Play like a prince in the difficulty setting of your choice!
👑 Royal support: +50% more starting coins.
👑 Royal bank: +10% more interest at the end of each wave.
👑 Royal archers: +1 damage per archer, and they pick a new target with each shot.

New board "Final Cloud"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/03c321be828b833dbab93feda8efa0ba44770504.png
Unlock the "Final Cloud" board after triumphing over Clouds 1, 2, 3.

New achievement: Octogolem

New boss!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/89aee9f453cfb3dafd9c631cbc3336edddeb6e68.png
Will you defeat the Octogolem?

Unlock tips!
Tips are now available to see in game in the settings.
Do not hesitate to check them out.

UI changes:
New pictogram on totems for classic nightmare victory.
Fix - Nightmare mode color change.

More:
Board 7 - Modifications to Adventurer and Veteran difficulties.
Bonus 1 - Lighting change.
Victory screen slightly modified.
Pause screen slightly modified.
Fix - Turkish 100% translated (some texts were missing).
Fix - Behavior of exclamation marks highlighting new features.
Fix - Info zone initialization at map launch.
Fix - Gamepad button sprites on SteamDeck.


[hr][/hr]
New free Demo!

Discover and try the game on 7 boards!

notes.title: Artisan TD 1.2: The Floating Ruins update has arrived!
notes.content:
The Floating Ruins update has arrived!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/b0fdf92044ca6199c04cba350a23f530d90a0a18.png

Hello dear explorers.

Thanks to your many feedbacks, we were able to identify and resolve several frustrating aspects of the game, particularly regarding balancing and the lack of explanations for certain mechanics. Your constructive criticism has greatly helped us make improvements and make Artisan TD more accessible and enjoyable.
A big thank you for your support!

We have added tips to better explain strategies and adjusted difficulty levels. We are also offering 3 new boards and a new power, Quick Shot, which allows a tower to instantly fire and reset its targeting, usable multiple times per wave. At the same time, we optimized several technical aspects: full controller support, improved zoom, DLSS/FSR support, and rebalancing of towers and waves on certain maps.

We look forward to your feedback and will continue to improve the game.

For the honor and glory of the Artisan Guild!

Content Addition

3 New Boards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/cc6542e7aa66c57cb06faeb05bd503507089103b.png

[hr][/hr]

Patch v1.2

🧩 New:

 3 bonus boards. (unlocked at boards 8, 18, and 28)
 Quick Shot: In-game power that recharges with each wave.
 Tips screen filled with useful advice.
 Full controller support.
 DLSS 2.2 & FSR 1.0 available.
 3 new Steam achievements.

📐 Balancing:

 The resale rate in “Veteran” difficulty has been increased from 50% to 75%.
 Wave balancing fixes (maps 9 & 11). 
 Flamethrower: Burns stronger for a shorter duration for better efficiency. 
 Ray: Increased damage and range. 
 Darts: Increased frequency. 
 Arbalist: Slight increase in fire rate. 
 Arbalist Elite: Slight range increase. 
 Catapult: Slight splash damage increase. 
 Tower rotation reset between each wave. 
 
🔨 Bug Fixes: 
 
 Fixed a crash bug after the defeat popup. 
 Controller: Fixed navigation through holes. 
 Controller: Monster arrival vibration no longer triggers when using the mouse. 
 Controller: Information displayed when changing difficulty. 
 Controller: Adjusted ergonomics and feel. 
 UI: Button logic fixed.

✨ Polish: 
 
 Improved camera control when zoom is active.
 Improved rebind options menus.
 Monster health bars hidden when the game is paused.
 Graphical improvements on board 12.
 Environment touch-ups for zooming.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/745843a1806b7a707faceffd04dc0e8dbe128c05.png Trading cards and point shop items are now available!

notes.title: Artisan TD: What's next?
notes.content:
Artisan TD has already been out for 2 weeks.
We really want to thank you so much for the way you've received the game.
Whether on our discord, in discussions, or even on Steam reviews, your support has been incredible, and our little team is immensely proud to have transported you across this archipelago, even if some of you haven't finished exploring!

We wanted to share a little news with you today to tell you what's next for our game. Over the last 15 days we've been fixing a lot of bugs, making a few adjustments, communicating about the game, and it's been great to see your live feedback.

Now we can tell you a little bit about what's next for us.
The team will start working on a free content patch due for release late September / early October in which we'll be bringing content to the game. Whether it's maps, quality of life (QoL) tools, and other little things that will continue to improve the experience for all players.

Once again, thank you so much for everything you've shared with us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/0293bfce9effed8276f82392702ead83a81a4622.gif

- For the glory and honor of the Artisan's Guild!

Antoine, Arthur, Nina & Adrien

notes.title: Artisan TD : OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It's the day!

Artisan TD is available today, July 22 at 5:30pm. It's a great honor for us to be able to present this game, which we've been working on for over 2 years now.
We can't wait to see you discover the game, even if you had already seen a demo of it at Next Fest a few weeks ago...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/db01bbd376fe3bae263de52f3dda8c781df40fb3.gif

Artisan TD is the fruit of a small team of 3 full-time members. Attentive to your feedback, we'll continue to optimize the game and fix any bugs we haven't been able to identify before.
We're also planning other things for the game's near future, and there's no shortage of ideas!

You are our greatest motivation to continue this adventure.
If you've enjoyed the game, don't forget to put a positive review on Steam - it's a huge vote of support for the studio. You can also tell others about the game so that they can support the Artisan’s Guild, and compare your techniques for solving the levels.

We wish you all a great adventure, and look forward to hearing from you soon on Steam, Discord or on the networks.

- For the glory and honor of the Artisan's Guild !

notes.title: Artisan TD: Thank you very much!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/37d57168d7f8620832c0a894393afa52ac57bddb.png

Thank you for testing our game at Neo Fest. Many of you tried out the Artisan TD demo around the world, and we're very grateful!
Thanks to you, we've had the chance to be among the most-played demos of the festival, and that's a huge honor for us!

Given the number of people who asked for it over the weekend, we've decided to extend the availability of our demo for another week.
You'll now be able to complete the game on the difficulty level of your choice and adjust your mazes.

We'd also like to take this opportunity to thank you for all the feedback you've given us, both positive and negative, as well as (and above all) the bugs you've identified. They're helping us to prepare for the game's release on July 22 (in one month's time!).

MANY THANKS! 
Antoine, Arthur, Nina & Adrien

notes.title: Artisan TD: Next Fest
notes.content:
Welcome, brave adventurers, to Artisan TD!

The Next Fest has just started on Steam, and we're part of it!
Be among the first to discover the Archipelago of Chaos during the entire festival (from June 10th to 17th).

We take this great news as an opportunity to announce something else:
Artisan TD's release date has been postponed to July 22nd.
We need your feedback on the demo and a bit more time to deliver a game we can be proud of.
In the meantime, you can add the game to your wishlist and encourage your friends to do the same. It helps the game tremendously as well as its visibility for the future, and it's free!


Feel free to join our Unexpected Discord to discuss your demo experience and share your feedback in the "Artisan TD" channel!

notes.title: Artisan TD: Meet you in July 2024 !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/409abbac1aa4ed3e618cb7f34e0e9a79d565c984.png

Artisan TD releases in July 2024!

For us to know that 20.000 of you have wishlisted Artisan TD is incredibly uplifting. Every feedback we received has been a source of inspiration and allowed us to refine and improve the game.

July 2024, the challenge is on for the release of Artisan TD. We are working hard for it!
Stay tuned, because we cannot wait to reveal more in the coming weeks.
Thank you for being part of this adventure with us!

4rtisan team.
